name: ip-as-logo
title_zh: 圆滚滚小方块角色生成器，自带三种产品方向提案
tagline_zh: 画吉祥物总怕太普通？它先按你的产品推三个方向，再各出六款独立候选。圆润重形、双色克制、纯色底、主角压左下角。
tagline_en: Tired of generic mascots? It proposes 3 product-relevant directions, each with 6 distinct candidates. Chunky.
desc_en: Generate extremely simple, cute, personified square character images with rounded heavy forms, two purposeful character colors, one solid background color, and a dominant lower-corner composition. Use when creating an animal, creature, robot, ghost, plant, object, or other character image, including when the agent should infer three product-relevant directions and propose six independent candidate
why_zh: 不是随机抽个可爱图。它先推理产品语义再定角色方向，六选一不重样，构图和配色有硬约束。
why_en: Not random cute rolls. It reasons from your product to 3 directions, then 6 varied candidates each—with strict composition &.
limit_zh: 只出静态方形图，无透明底、无多视角、无动画帧。角色限动物/生物/机器人/幽灵/植物/物品六类，超出会硬套。
limit_en: Static square images only—no transparency, no turnaround, no animation. Covers 6 character types (animal/creature/robot/ghost/plant/object); others.
title_en: Round square character maker with 3 product directions
